title: HOW OPTIMAL TRANSPORT CAN TACKLE GENDER BIASES IN MULTI-CLASS NEURAL-NETWORK CLASSIFIERS FOR JOB RECOMMENDATIONS?

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the True Positive Rate gap (TPRg) between male and female individuals across different occupation classes predicted from their textual biographies (Bios dataset), and evaluating bias reduction using an optimal transport regularization technique (W2reg) compared to a baseline of removing explicit gender indicators and replacing names.
